question: Smart garbage bins made of Stainless Steel were launched by ______ in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steel Authority of India Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is one of the largest steel-making companies in India and one of the Maharatnas of India's central public sector enterprises.
 
• SAIL was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• In 2019, SAIL launched smart garbage bins made of stainless steel, which are designed to be robust, corrosion-resistant, and easy to maintain.
